title: Choose the visual world for the PyWall console
question: The roll assigned Sorting Office. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Sorting Office
options.lineage: Postal sorting offices: routing labels, sorting frames, cancellation postmarks
options.thesis: Every packet is addressed mail: read at the frame, then forwarded or held in the bin of the stage that stopped it.
options.viewport: Icon rail; a figure strip; the flow map with sources left, the sorting frame of pipeline stages centre, held-mail bins under each stage, destinations right; recent events beside it.
options.risk: Postal language can slide into costume; it is held to labels, bins and verdict marks only.

raised.raise: Dropped streams carry a hatch as well as coral, so allowed vs blocked never relies on colour alone.
One path geometry per stream drives its ribbon, its hit area and its selection highlight.
Every figure opens the packets behind it: no number without its evidence.
Four type sizes only; rank carried by weight and ink, not size.

options.label: Flow Cartography
options.lineage: Minard's 1869 flow map and engineering Sankey diagrams
options.thesis: Traffic drawn as rivers whose width is packet count; the firewall is the delta where they split.
options.viewport: Icon rail; the flow map owns two-thirds of the screen edge to edge, figures set as map annotations along it, events in a narrow right column.
options.risk: Closest to your reference screenshot and the direction most runs in this category land on.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Load as hatch density over an eleven-step zone ramp.
options.viewport: Overlapping translucent sheets over a zone wedge.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a classroom does not recognise darkroom records, and sheets obscure the pipeline.
options.risk: Magenta filtration colour fights the pinned teal/coral meaning.
options.kept: Conflict and state readable without colour (hatching).

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Traffic as a pulsar plot on matte black, names coded in colour.
options.viewport: One stacked-line plot owning the field, a catalog number as headline.
options.case: Fuses poorly: coded names defeat the teaching goal of explaining every verdict.
options.risk: Unreadable for a learner by design.

options.label: Timetable Rack
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight, case and reversal.
options.viewport: A raked rack of slides travelled sideways.
options.case: Fuses poorly: raked containers and lateral travel break a monitoring layout.
options.risk: Goldenrod ground contradicts the pinned charcoal.
options.kept: Rank by weight and ink at very few sizes.

options.label: Monochrome Proof
options.thesis: Every claim paired with the interface detail that proves it.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a marketing page structure, not a working console.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.thesis: Sections as hued divider boards under acetate leaves.
options.viewport: A stepped tab rail down the fore edge.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a hue per section breaks colour-means-state.
options.risk: Full-strength section hues collide with verdict colours.
options.kept: Stepped, instant state changes without decorative easing.

options.label: Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour divided by coastline.
options.case: Fuses poorly: cream ground and playful capsules contradict the brief.
options.kept: One geometry drives layout, hit area and state.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A security operations dashboard as the category ships it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, KPI strip, traffic chart with the flow view below, alerts table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
